name: Epidemic Sound search
summary: Search Epidemic Sound inside a panel with genre, mood, tempo and vocal filters, audition hits, then save a whole download list to your own library folder in one assistant run and place saved tracks on the open Draft.

compatibility.selects: Needs Panel runShell, runScript, askAI and Selects browser control, and your own Epidemic Sound account. macOS uses the system python3 and curl. Windows 10 1803+/11 uses the built-in Windows PowerShell 5.1 and curl.exe by full path, so the Selects shell's System32-only PATH and temporary HOME are fine. Every host step (settings, library, search, waveform, cover art, Downloads scan, moving files) was exercised on Windows Server 2022 and 2025 under the same cmd.exe setup Selects uses, with output identical to macOS; the Windows folder picker, File Explorer reveal and in-app browser download are not yet verified on a Windows desktop. Linux is unsupported.

de.name: Epidemic Sound-Suche
de.summary: Durchsucht Epidemic Sound direkt im Panel mit Genre-, Stimmungs-, Tempo- und Gesangsfiltern, spielt Treffer zur Probe ab, speichert eine ganze Downloadliste in einem Assistentenlauf in den eigenen Bibliotheksordner und setzt gespeicherte Titel in den offenen Draft.

en.name: Epidemic Sound search
en.summary: Search Epidemic Sound inside a panel with genre, mood, tempo and vocal filters, audition hits, then save a whole download list to your own library folder in one assistant run and place saved tracks on the open Draft.

es.name: Buscador de Epidemic Sound
es.summary: Busca en Epidemic Sound desde el panel con filtros de género, estado de ánimo, tempo y voces, escucha los resultados, guarda toda una lista de descargas en tu carpeta de biblioteca en una sola ejecución del asistente y coloca las pistas guardadas en el Draft abierto.

fr.name: Recherche Epidemic Sound
fr.summary: Recherche dans Epidemic Sound depuis le panneau avec des filtres de genre, d'ambiance, de tempo et de voix, écoute les résultats, enregistre toute une liste de téléchargements dans votre dossier de bibliothèque en une seule exécution de l'assistant et place les morceaux enregistrés sur le Draft ouvert.

it.name: Ricerca Epidemic Sound
it.summary: Cerca su Epidemic Sound dal pannello con filtri per genere, mood, tempo e voce, ascolta i risultati, salva un'intera lista di download nella tua cartella libreria in una sola esecuzione dell'assistente e inserisce i brani salvati nel Draft aperto.

ja.name: Epidemic Sound 検索
ja.summary: パネル内で Epidemic Sound をジャンル・ムード・テンポ・ボーカルの条件で検索し、試聴し、ダウンロードリストをまとめてアシスタントの 1 回の実行で自分のライブラリフォルダーに保存して、保存した曲を開いている Draft に配置します。

ko.name: Epidemic Sound 검색
ko.summary: 패널 안에서 장르·무드·템포·보컬 필터로 Epidemic Sound를 검색하고 미리 들어본 뒤, 다운로드 목록 전체를 어시스턴트 한 번의 실행으로 내 라이브러리 폴더에 저장하고 저장한 트랙을 열려 있는 Draft에 배치합니다.

pt.name: Pesquisa Epidemic Sound
pt.summary: Pesquisa no Epidemic Sound a partir do painel com filtros de género, ambiente, andamento e vozes, ouve os resultados, guarda uma lista de transferências inteira na tua pasta de biblioteca numa única execução do assistente e coloca as faixas guardadas no Draft aberto.

tr.name: Epidemic Sound arama
tr.summary: Epidemic Sound'u panelin içinde tür, mod, tempo ve vokal filtreleriyle arar, sonuçları dinletir, tüm indirme listesini tek bir asistan çalıştırmasıyla kendi kitaplık klasörünüze kaydeder ve kaydedilen parçaları açık Draft'a yerleştirir.

zh.name: Epidemic Sound 搜索
zh.summary: 在面板内按流派、情绪、速度和人声筛选搜索 Epidemic Sound，直接试听，把整份下载清单在一次助手运行中保存到你自己的音乐库文件夹，并把已保存的曲目放到打开的 Draft 上。
